title: Mangiferin alleviates 6-OHDA-induced Parkinson's disease by inhibiting AKR1C3 to activate Wnt signaling pathway.
authors: Huang, Wanran; Wang, Yanni; Huang, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芒果苷对帕金森病的神经保护作用，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative disorder with a lack of effective treatment options. mangiferin, a bioactive compound derived from mango, has been shown to possess strong neuroprotective properties. In this study, we investigated the neuroprotective effects of mangiferin on PD and its underlying mechanisms using both in vitro and in vivo models of 6-OHDA-induced PD. Additionally, we conducted molecular docking experiments to evaluate the interaction between mangiferin and AKR1C3 and beta-catenin. Our results demonstrated that treatment with mangiferin significantly attenuated 6-OHDA-induced cell damage in PC12 cells, reducing intracellular oxidative stress, improving mitochondrial membrane potential, and restoring the expression of tyrosine hydroxylase (TH), a characteristic protein of dopaminergic neurons. Furthermore, mangiferin reduced the accumulation of alpha-synuclein and inhibited the expression of AKR1C3, thereby activating the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. In vivo studies revealed that mangiferin improved motor dysfunction in 6-OHDA-induced PD mice. Molecular docking analysis confirmed the interaction between mangiferin and AKR1C3 and beta-catenin. These findings indicate that mangiferin exerts significant neuroprotective effects in 6-OHDA-induced PD by inhibiting AKR1C3 and activating the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. Therefore, mangiferin may emerge as an innovative therapeutic strategy in the comprehensive treatment regimen of PD patients, providing them with better clinical outcomes and quality of life.
abstract_zh: 帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）是一种缺乏有效治疗方案的神经退行性疾病。芒果苷（mangiferin），一种源自芒果的生物活性化合物，已被证明具有强大的神经保护特性。在本研究中，我们利用6-OHDA诱导的PD体外和体内模型，探讨了芒果苷对PD的神经保护作用及其潜在机制。此外，我们进行了分子对接实验，以评估芒果苷与AKR1C3和β-catenin之间的相互作用。我们的结果表明，芒果苷处理显著减轻了6-OHDA诱导的PC12细胞损伤，降低了细胞内氧化应激，改善了线粒体膜电位，并恢复了酪氨酸羟化酶（tyrosine hydroxylase, TH）的表达，这是多巴胺能神经元的特征性蛋白。此外，芒果苷减少了α-突触核蛋白的积累，并抑制了AKR1C3的表达，从而激活了Wnt/β-catenin信号通路。体内研究显示，芒果苷改善了6-OHDA诱导的PD小鼠的运动功能障碍。分子对接分析确认了芒果苷与AKR1C3和β-catenin之间的相互作用。这些发现表明，芒果苷通过抑制AKR1C3并激活Wnt/β-catenin信号通路，在6-OHDA诱导的PD中发挥了显著的神经保护作用。因此，芒果苷可能成为PD患者综合治疗方案中的一种创新治疗策略，为他们提供更好的临床结局和生活质量。
